project.name: cargotracker
project.description: Django implementation of the Cargo Tracker domain-driven design sample, organised into bounded contexts (booking, cargo, handling, location, voyage, pathfinder). Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

layers.name: Interfaces
layers.description: Views, forms, REST/JSON APIs, URL routing and HTML templates that expose each bounded context to users and clients.

layers.name: Application Services
layers.description: Use-case orchestration, composition roots and management commands coordinating domain objects.

layers.name: Domain Model
layers.description: Entities, value objects, aggregates and repository interfaces of the cargo, handling, location, voyage and pathfinder contexts.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Persistence
layers.description: Django ORM models, repository implementations, migrations and app configs.

layers.name: Project Configuration & Data Migration
layers.description: Django settings, ASGI/WSGI entry points, root URLs, package markers and data snapshot tooling.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Cargotracker is a Django take on the DDD Cargo Tracker sample, split into bounded contexts. Start with the settings and root URL configuration.

tour.title: Cargo Domain Core
tour.description: The cargo aggregate, its itinerary, legs, route specification and delivery progress form the heart of the model.

tour.title: Location and Voyage Contexts
tour.description: Locations (UN/LOCODE) and voyages with schedules and carrier movements support cargo routing.

tour.title: Handling Context
tour.description: Handling events, registration attempts and history record what happens to cargo.

tour.title: Pathfinder Context
tour.description: Pathfinder computes candidate transit paths exposed over an API.

tour.title: Booking Application and UI
tour.description: Booking dashboard, registration wizard and routing services tie contexts together for the admin user.

tour.title: Tracking and Live Map
tour.description: Public tracking views, history, ETA and the admin live map.

tour.title: Persistence
tour.description: Repositories and ORM models implement the domain repository interfaces.

tour.title: Data Tooling
tour.description: Sample data seeding and snapshot export/load commands.
